name: Brass
author: Lyle Mills, after Perry R. Cook and Gary P. Scavone
description: A lip-reed brass instrument. Breath makes it speak, and the lip knob climbs the bore's harmonic series the way a bugle player does.

controls.label: Lip
controls.description: Lip tension. Climbs the bore's partials -- unison, fifth, octave, tenth, twelfth -- and bends each one sharp as it rises.

controls.label: Breath
controls.description: Raises breath pressure from gentle to strong while staying above the model's oscillation threshold across the full range.

controls.label: Bell
controls.description: Bell size, from a stopped horn that barely sustains to an open one that rings and overblows easily.

controls.label: Buzz
controls.description: Buzz. How far the lips swing into closure each cycle -- a soft flutter at the bottom, a real mouthpiece buzz at the top.

outputs.main: Pressure inside the mouthpiece; the stereo toggle does not change this fixed MAIN/AUX pair.
outputs.aux: Valve flow that drives the bore; the stereo toggle does not change this fixed MAIN/AUX pair.

trigger: Empties the bore and resets the lips so each note starts the same way.
upstream: After STK Brass (Cook's TBone/HosePlayer); redesigned because upstream does not sustain
